delayed_gratification.definition: The willingness to give up a smaller reward now for a larger reward later.

gd_documentation.definition: The written record that keeps a shared account alive when memory is attacked.
gd_documentation.example: The documentation was a handover note, a date and a message.

gd_gaslighting.definition: A repeated attack on a person's memory and judgement, so that they stop trusting what they remember.
gd_gaslighting.example: It was gaslighting: she was told her own account of the meeting was wrong.

opening_balance.definition: The amount in the account at the start of the statement period. Every figure that follows is measured from it.
opening_balance.example: The opening balance was 500 $, so the first transaction was charged against that.

pet.definition: An animal that lives with people, like a dog, a cat or a fish.
pet.example: My dog is a pet. He sleeps on my bed.
